Rellor

Bug

Paldea · Generation 9

Rellor is a Bug-type Rolling Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves into Rabsca. Its highest base stat is Defense (60), with a base stat total of 270.
